arxiv-2303-14048.description: Abstract . Thresholded mode-switched ODEs are restricted dynamical systems that switch ODEs depending on digital input signals only, and produce a digital output signal by thresholding some internal signal. Such systems arise in recent digital circuit delay models, where the analog signals within a gate are governed by ODEs that change depending on the digital inputs.

arxiv-2408-13768.title: EVALUATION OF FISSION FRAGMENT MOMENTS OF INERTIA FOR SPONTANEOUS FISSION OF CF-252
arxiv-2408-13768.creator: D.E. Lyubashevsky, P.V. Kostryukov, A.A. Pisklyukov, J.D. Shcherbina
arxiv-2408-13768.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by D.E. Lyubashevsky, P.V. Kostryukov, A.A. Pisklyukov, J.D. Shcherbina. Current work discusses methods for estimating the moments of inertia of fission fragments for spontaneous fission of the isotope Cf-252, in particular, two main approaches are mentioned: statistical and microscopic. pmc-12637072.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). uslaw-usc-t14-s2124.title: 14 U.S.C. § 2124 — Promotions; pay and allowances
uslaw-usc-t14-s2124.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t14-s2124.description: United States Code, Title 14 (Coast Guard); Chapter 21 (Personnel; Officers); Subchapter I (Appointment And Promotion). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. An officer who is promoted under section 2121 of this title shall be entitled to the pay and allowances of the grade to which promoted from his date of rank in such grade.
